data.body: **[P1] Give distinct durable payloads distinct entity IDs.** Using only the operation ID means an invoke request, its result, and its exception all receive the same identity. A context-aware SerDes that derives a deterministic external-storage key from `entityId` can therefore overwrite the request with the result; if the invoked durable function subsequently replays, it may deserialize the result as its original input. Add stable payload-kind suffixes such as `/invoke-payload`, `/result`, and `/exception` (and corresponding root input/output IDs), update testing/history reconstruction, and add a replay test using deterministic external storage.
